trendlyne_description: ITC Hotels Ltd. is a hospitality chain in India that transitioned into an independent entity following its demerger from ITC Ltd. in January 2025. The company operates a portfolio of over 145 properties with 13,600+ keys across six distinctive brands... Read More
screener_description: ITC Hotels is an Indian hospitality company that operates and manages hotels, with over 200 hotels. It has a franchise agreement to operate most of its hotels as part of The Luxury Collection of Marriott International. It operates hotels across 90+ destinations under brands like ITC Hotels, Mementos, Epiq Collection Storii, Welcomhotel, Fortune, and Welcome Heritage. [1] [2]
